$comment: Wave V3 (feedback and status) of docs/COMPONENT-VARIANTS-PLAN.md: per component its variants and motion, and per pack whether each is built. The class is bx-<kind>--<variant> on the component root; React Native reads the variant from its theme (variantStyles). Merged into variants.json.
